Theme: HotCRM usable, with a named effect. It is live on HotCRM main today: with Project Delivery disabled, the whole Expenses list fails with 400 instead of dropping one column. So p1.

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Re: repo:hotcrm#1's request (16:15Z) · 2026-11-17T16:15Z

This card is already **p1**. It was graded at first touch in R1198 on its own effect: the HotCRM Expenses list breaks when Project Delivery is off.

As of 16:11Z, the HotCRM maintainer has chosen that the platform fixes it and that the next HotCRM release waits on it. So addendum 9 now applies as well: p1 holds for as long as HotCRM waits on this card, whatever its effect grade becomes.

It is queued for the p1 seat (repo:objectstack#3).

## Seat ruling on route · 2026-11-17T19:09Z

From area o3-A's measurement (report 6958031017, main cb7d514ac1): with package P disabled, Q's view keeps a column on P's contributed field and every query axis is refused (select via `assertProjectionFieldsExist`, filter / groupBy / searchFields `INVALID_FIELD`, orderBy `INVALID_SORT`).

**Route A2.** The server stamps the withheld field names on the served object read with an underscore-private marker (fed from `withholdDisabledExtensions`), and the console drops those names on every query axis, as #34807 / #34898 do for draft-only fields. The data door and the stored view stay unchanged: a typo stays a 400, and re-enabling P restores the column with no write. Rejected: A1 (silently hides all drift and needs a PIN 4 reversal), B (the personalization PUT and Studio would persist the strip, breaking re-enable), C (a widening that cuts against ruling 6946403206).

Conditions:
- The ListView sort persist boundary (#30024) must not drop a withheld sort: pin that a save while P is disabled keeps the sort and the column.
- Measure, before coding, whether the view save door refuses Q's view while P is disabled, and report it; if it does, that is in scope.
- `Clause-②: no`. The served object shape is a contract face, so declare the marker as underscore-private (not authorable) and the seat runs an L2 after L1-d.
- Large card, kept in area o3-A; claim restated with the measured file list (objectql / metadata-protocol / ui).
